0211__L3_POL_115__7DBCACAA.mp3.asr_text: Hell, how much armor do you suppose they got left?
0211__L3_POL_115__7DBCACAA.mp3.translation: 妈的，你说他们还剩多少坦克？

0212__L3_POL_105__7C07D40B.mp3.asr_text: Get going, Miller, while there's still an 8th Division left!
0212__L3_POL_105__7C07D40B.mp3.translation: 快点，米勒，别等第八师的人全死光了！
0212__L3_POL_105__7C07D40B.mp3.note: ASR及AM参考均称8th Division，按游戏台词译为第八师，不另按历史编制改写。

0213__L3_SUL_101__F4363504.mp3.asr_text: Let's go get up to that structure and take out those MGs!
0213__L3_SUL_101__F4363504.mp3.translation: 冲到那栋建筑去，干掉那些机枪！

0215__L3_8th_98__3A6B0067.mp3.asr_text: No one, sir! The officers are all dead and we're getting worn down!
0215__L3_8th_98__3A6B0067.mp3.translation: 没人了，长官！军官全死了，我们快撑不住了！

0216__L3_SUL_99__BB2F4C8A.mp3.asr_text: And it's time we get out of here. All of us. You read me.
0216__L3_SUL_99__BB2F4C8A.mp3.translation: 那就该离开这儿了，一个都不能落下。听明白没有？

0217__L3_SUL_100__F4281D83.mp3.asr_text: Miller! Move forward and find us a route around this place!
0217__L3_SUL_100__F4281D83.mp3.translation: 米勒！到前面去，找条路绕过去！

0218__L3_POL_95__64800123.mp3.asr_text: You kidding me? That place is a fortress!
0218__L3_POL_95__64800123.mp3.translation: 开什么玩笑？那地方简直是座堡垒！

0219__L3_SUL_27__AF21312F.mp3.asr_text: We done? Okay, let's move on.

0220__L3_SUL_66__B5E67C2A.mp3.asr_text: Move inside! Find the radar equipment and destroy it!
0220__L3_SUL_66__B5E67C2A.mp3.translation: 冲进去！找到雷达设备，毁掉它！

0221__L3_SUL_33__B09DABCA.mp3.asr_text: Okay Marines, what do you say we give those guys a fighting chance? Time to take out those guns. Mount out!
0221__L3_SUL_33__B09DABCA.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，给咱们的人争条活路怎么样？该去端掉那些炮了，出发！

0222__L3_SUL_41__B2365567.mp3.asr_text: You all know the drill. Clear out those trenches and get to those AA guns!
0222__L3_SUL_41__B2365567.mp3.translation: 都知道怎么干。清掉战壕里的敌人，冲到那些高射炮跟前！

0223__L3_SUL_26__AF1319AE.mp3.asr_text: Keep moving! Spread out and mop up this place!
0223__L3_SUL_26__AF1319AE.mp3.translation: 继续推进！散开，把这地方清干净！

0224__L3_SUL_54__B4157489.mp3.asr_text: Good shooting, Miller. Those flyboys owe us one.
0224__L3_SUL_54__B4157489.mp3.translation: 打得好，米勒。那帮飞行员欠我们一个人情。

0225__L3_SUL_55__B4238C0A.mp3.note: Cutter疑似人名Carter误识别，结合紧接的卡特回应统一为卡特。

0226__L3_CAR_56__4988F2C1.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant Roebuck, battalion says there's an enemy radar station near our position that's coordinating their air defense. They want us to take it out.
0226__L3_CAR_56__4988F2C1.mp3.translation: 罗巴克中士，营部说这附近有个敌军雷达站，负责协调他们的防空火力。要我们把它端了。

0227__L3_SUL_57__B43FBB0C.mp3.asr_text: Alright Marines, still ain't earned our paychecks today I guess.
0227__L3_SUL_57__B43FBB0C.mp3.translation: 好吧，弟兄们，看来今天这份军饷还没挣够。

0228__L3_SUL_15__AD50298E.mp3.asr_text: We've got more enemy in those ruins! They got us cold! Take cover!
0228__L3_SUL_15__AD50298E.mp3.translation: 废墟里还有敌人！他们卡住了我们，找掩护！

0229__L3_POL_16__56E753AC.mp3.asr_text: Great! We're back to being pinned down again!
0229__L3_POL_16__56E753AC.mp3.translation: 真棒，又被压得动不了了！

0230__L3_SUL_42__B2446CE8.mp3.asr_text: Keep on going! Hear those AA guns? That's our objective!
0230__L3_SUL_42__B2446CE8.mp3.translation: 继续走！听见高射炮了吗？那就是目标！

0231__L3_SUL_49__B2A7116F.mp3.asr_text: Do not stop! We do our job so those birds can do theirs.
0231__L3_SUL_49__B2A7116F.mp3.translation: 别停！我们干好自己的活，那些飞机才能干好他们的。

0232__L3_POL_83__62AEF982.mp3.asr_text: What, we gotta go bail out the 8th now? Who next, my mother and queens?
0232__L3_POL_83__62AEF982.mp3.translation: 怎么，又要去救第八师？接下来去救谁，我在皇后区的老妈？
0232__L3_POL_83__62AEF982.mp3.note: ASR的mother and queens疑似mother in Queens，按皇后区的母亲理解，待听音。

0233__L3_CAR_0__6D710F4C.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant Roebuck? Ain't we supposed to be taking the airfield?
0233__L3_CAR_0__6D710F4C.mp3.translation: 罗巴克中士，我们不是来拿机场的吗？

0234__L3_MA1_4__C9E0B7D9.mp3.asr_text: Look! Someone's going for that bunker!
0234__L3_MA1_4__C9E0B7D9.mp3.translation: 看！有人朝那个碉堡冲过去了！

0237__L4_Sul_59__15E8F9AE.mp3.asr_text: Miller, grab that bazooka, that's an order!
0237__L4_Sul_59__15E8F9AE.mp3.translation: 米勒，拿起那支巴祖卡，这是命令！

0238__L4_Sul_58__15DAE22D.mp3.asr_text: We ain't got all day, Miller! Get that bazooka!
0238__L4_Sul_58__15DAE22D.mp3.translation: 没空等你，米勒！快拿巴祖卡！

0239__L3_SUL_65__B5D864A9.mp3.asr_text: Right, Miller! Take care of him!

0240__L3_POL_107__7C24030D.mp3.asr_text: There's more of them on the roof. This way, Miller.
0240__L3_POL_107__7C24030D.mp3.translation: 屋顶上还有敌人。米勒，这边！

0241__L3_POL_102__7BDD8D88.mp3.asr_text: Enemies coming out of that building! Don't stop, push right through them!
0241__L3_POL_102__7BDD8D88.mp3.translation: 敌人从那栋楼里出来了！别停，杀过去！

0242__L3_SUL_67__B5F493AB.mp3.asr_text: Good work, Miller! Those enemy fighters will be flying blind now!
0242__L3_SUL_67__B5F493AB.mp3.translation: 干得好，米勒！这下敌人的战斗机可要成瞎子了！

0243__L3_SUL_45__B26EB36B.mp3.asr_text: Miller, there's a gun up ahead. We'll cover you. Take out the crew.
0243__L3_SUL_45__B26EB36B.mp3.translation: 米勒，前面有门炮。我们掩护你，干掉炮手。

0244__L3_POL_58__5DD6E52A.mp3.asr_text: Up ahead! Is that the radar station?

0245__L3_SUL_59__B45BEA0E.mp3.asr_text: Looks like the place. We gotta get inside and shut the radar down.
0245__L3_SUL_59__B45BEA0E.mp3.translation: 应该就是这儿。要进去把雷达关掉。

0247__L3_POL_38__5A6D33EC.mp3.asr_text: Japanese assault! Hell, they're headed straight for us!
0247__L3_POL_38__5A6D33EC.mp3.translation: 日本人冲上来了！妈的，直奔咱们来的！

0248__L3_SUL_51__B3EB2E06.mp3.asr_text: Marines! Put some suppressing fire on that position!
0248__L3_SUL_51__B3EB2E06.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，用火力压住那个阵地！

0249__L3_SUL_84__B933FE66.mp3.note: Semper Fi按陆战队口号译为永远忠诚。

0250__L3_POL_74__61083864.mp3.asr_text: Guess they want their radar station back!
0250__L3_POL_74__61083864.mp3.translation: 看来他们想把雷达站抢回去！

0251__L3_SUL_75__B78D3D48.mp3.asr_text: All we're giving them is a kick in the teeth. Let them have it, Marines!
0251__L3_SUL_75__B78D3D48.mp3.translation: 那就让他们碰一鼻子灰。弟兄们，狠狠地打！

0252__L3_SUL_1__91F834C3.mp3.asr_text: Yeah, well, the airfield's over there. And we're pinned down here. You got any ideas how we're going to get past the Japanese? Then I'm listening.
0252__L3_SUL_1__91F834C3.mp3.translation: 是啊，机场在那边，我们却被困在这儿。你要是知道怎么突破日军，就说来听听。

0253__L3_POL_5__661C388A.mp3.asr_text: That guy's gotta be out of his mind. Who the hell is he?
0253__L3_POL_5__661C388A.mp3.translation: 那家伙疯了吧？他到底是谁？

0254__L3_SUL_9__9268F0CB.mp3.asr_text: That crazy fool just took the whole bunker by himself! On your feet, Marines! Time to get in a fight! HUT!
0254__L3_SUL_9__9268F0CB.mp3.translation: 那疯子一个人拿下了整座碉堡！弟兄们，起来！轮到咱们上了！快！

0255__L3_POL_117__7DD8DBAC.mp3.asr_text: Miller! I need a hand here, pal!
0255__L3_POL_117__7DD8DBAC.mp3.translation: 米勒！伙计，快来帮我一把！

0257__L3_SUL_103__F4526406.mp3.asr_text: Get inside! Let's clear this place out!

0259__L3_POL_30__59FC77E4.mp3.asr_text: Same old Flyboys. As far above the rough stuff as they can get.
0259__L3_POL_30__59FC77E4.mp3.translation: 飞行员还是老样子，离下面这些烂摊子越远越好。

0260__L3_SUL_35__B0B9DACC.mp3.asr_text: Watch out! The runway's mined! Use the craters to get across! Miller, on point!
0260__L3_SUL_35__B0B9DACC.mp3.translation: 小心！跑道上有雷！借着弹坑穿过去！米勒，打头阵！

0261__L3_POL_68__5F8BBDC9.mp3.asr_text: Ah hell, we got incoming! Japanese armor heading this way!
0261__L3_POL_68__5F8BBDC9.mp3.translation: 妈的，有敌人过来了！鬼子坦克正朝这边开！

0262__L3_SUL_72__B762F6C5.mp3.asr_text: Carter, get on the radio! Time to call in that favor from the Air Corps!
0262__L3_SUL_72__B762F6C5.mp3.translation: 卡特，呼叫空中支援！该让那帮飞行员还人情了！

0263__L3_SUL_47__B28AE26D.mp3.asr_text: Same drill. Clear the trench and find the gun.
0263__L3_SUL_47__B28AE26D.mp3.translation: 老办法。清掉战壕里的敌人，找到那门炮。

0264__L3_POL_17__56F56B2D.mp3.asr_text: You see that? They're coming out of that bunker. Pretty soon they're gonna be crawling all over us. We gotta get out of here, Sergeant, and I mean fast!
0264__L3_POL_17__56F56B2D.mp3.translation: 看见没？他们正从碉堡里出来。再拖下去，到处都是鬼子。中士，咱们得赶紧离开这儿，越快越好！

0269__L3_SUL_34__B0ABC34B.mp3.asr_text: Need to get across the runway. Move, Marines!

0270__L3_POL_48__5C220C8B.mp3.asr_text: They're freaking everywhere, I tell you! Get them!
0270__L3_POL_48__5C220C8B.mp3.translation: 我就说他们到处都是！干掉他们！

0271__L3_SUL_53__B4075D08.mp3.asr_text: Machine guns down! Take out that AA!
0271__L3_SUL_53__B4075D08.mp3.translation: 机枪哑了！干掉那门高射炮！

0272__L3_SUL_88__B96C5C6A.mp3.asr_text: Get to that revetment on the other side of the runway. Move it!
0272__L3_SUL_88__B96C5C6A.mp3.translation: 到跑道另一边的掩体去，快！

0273__L3_SUL_90__BAB07901.mp3.asr_text: Hold your fire! Those are friendlies from the ape!
0273__L3_SUL_90__BAB07901.mp3.translation: 停火！那是第八师的自己人！
0273__L3_SUL_90__BAB07901.mp3.note: ASR的ape疑似8th误识别，结合场景中的第八师援军拟译。

0274__L3_SUL_92__BACCA803.mp3.asr_text: Where it is you boys found the enemy HQ?
0274__L3_SUL_92__BACCA803.mp3.translation: 听说你们找到敌军指挥部了？

0275__L3_8th_93__3A248AE2.mp3.asr_text: Yes, sir. But enemy machine gun fires got it locked up tight. We can't get to it. Some of us tried and got pinned down up ahead.
0275__L3_8th_93__3A248AE2.mp3.translation: 是，长官。但敌人的机枪封死了那儿，根本过不去。有些人试着冲过去，被压在前面了。

0276__L3_SUL_94__BAE8D705.mp3.asr_text: Is that right? What do you say we move up together and take a peek?
0276__L3_SUL_94__BAE8D705.mp3.translation: 是吗？那咱们一起上去瞧瞧，怎么样？

0277__L3_POL_2__65F1F207.mp3.asr_text: I say we just give him Miller. That'll make him surrender for sure.
0277__L3_POL_2__65F1F207.mp3.translation: 要我说，把米勒送给他们，他们肯定投降。

0278__L3_SUL_6__923EAA48.mp3.asr_text: Whoever he is, he needs covering fire. Get on him!
0278__L3_SUL_6__923EAA48.mp3.translation: 不管他是谁，先掩护他！开火！

0279__L3_SUL_11__AD17CB8A.mp3.asr_text: Damn it! The fire just came from that building! Get in there! He opened up a hole for us! Don't let it go to waste!
0279__L3_SUL_11__AD17CB8A.mp3.translation: 妈的，枪是从那栋楼打来的！冲进去！他给我们打开了缺口，别白费了！

0280__L4_Sul_77__19367BEA.mp3.asr_text: Miller, grab the bazooka and use it on that armor. Buy us some time.
0280__L4_Sul_77__19367BEA.mp3.translation: 米勒，拿巴祖卡打那些坦克，给我们争取点时间。

0283__L3_POL_121__7F392745.mp3.asr_text: Well, well! Look who finally decided to show up at the party! It's the sixth marine!
0283__L3_POL_121__7F392745.mp3.translation: 哟，总算舍得来凑热闹了！是陆战六师！
0283__L3_POL_121__7F392745.mp3.note: 原AM和ASR都指第六部队/师，此处沿用游戏所称陆战六师。

0284__L3_MA1_123__38DD7917.mp3.asr_text: We got armor too! Those Shermers will chew right through the Japanese tanks!
0284__L3_MA1_123__38DD7917.mp3.translation: 我们也有坦克了！谢尔曼对付日军坦克还不是轻而易举！
0284__L3_MA1_123__38DD7917.mp3.note: Shermers疑似Shermans，按谢尔曼坦克修正。

0285__L3_CAR_124__0D5CC44F.mp3.asr_text: I ain't never been so happy to see those damn doggies!
0285__L3_CAR_124__0D5CC44F.mp3.translation: 我这辈子就没这么盼着见到那帮陆军！

0286__L3_CAR_125__0D6ADBD0.mp3.asr_text: It's battalion, Sergeant! They say enemy resistance on BDO is finished! The island's ours!
0286__L3_CAR_125__0D6ADBD0.mp3.translation: 营部来电，中士！贝蒂奥岛上的敌人已经不行了！这岛归我们了！
0286__L3_CAR_125__0D6ADBD0.mp3.note: BDO疑似Betio谐音，AM可佐证岛名，修正为贝蒂奥。

0287__L3_SUL_126__F7E65BC7.mp3.asr_text: Alright, Marines, we got one, but don't kick up your feet yet. We still got plenty more to go. This fight is far from over.
0287__L3_SUL_126__F7E65BC7.mp3.translation: 好，弟兄们，又拿下一个岛。但还没到歇脚的时候，后头还有的是仗要打。这场仗还远没结束。

0288__L3_SUL_109__F4A6F10C.mp3.note: Pulaski疑似Polonsky误识别，AM原文及下一句回应可佐证。

0289__L3_POL_110__7D763725.mp3.asr_text: Hey, don't look at me, sir. Dank Miller here. Guy's turning into a real tiger.
0289__L3_POL_110__7D763725.mp3.translation: 别看我，长官。该谢旁边这位米勒，这家伙越打越猛了。
0289__L3_POL_110__7D763725.mp3.note: Dank Miller疑似Thank Miller，按感谢米勒理解。

0291__L3_SUL_112__F5F92524.mp3.asr_text: Ah hell! That counterattack didn't take long. Carter! Get on the radio!
0291__L3_SUL_112__F5F92524.mp3.translation: 妈的，这么快就反扑了。卡特！用无线电呼叫！

0292__L3_CAR_113__0B99D42F.mp3.asr_text: Aye aye, sir! Already on it!

0293__L3_SUL_114__F6155426.mp3.asr_text: Support's coming Marines! Just gotta hold out until it gets here!
0293__L3_SUL_114__F6155426.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，援军正在赶来！撑到他们来就行！

0295__L3_SUL_104__F4607B87.mp3.asr_text: Keep on going! Miller, clear the next story!
0295__L3_SUL_104__F4607B87.mp3.translation: 继续推进！米勒，清理上一层！

0296__L3_SUL_40__B2283DE6.mp3.asr_text: Outstanding! Now take that trench up ahead!
0296__L3_SUL_40__B2283DE6.mp3.translation: 干得漂亮！拿下前面那条战壕！

0297__L3_SUL_46__B27CCAEC.mp3.asr_text: Good work, Miller. Now let's see about doing the same to the next one.
0297__L3_SUL_46__B27CCAEC.mp3.translation: 干得好，米勒。下一门也照样收拾。

0298__L3_POL_64__5F535FC5.mp3.asr_text: Up there! Japanese riflemen on the roof!
0298__L3_POL_64__5F535FC5.mp3.translation: 上面！日军步枪手在屋顶上！

0300__L3_POL_50__5D662922.mp3.asr_text: Machine Gun Nest! They got that AA covered nine ways to Sunday!
0300__L3_POL_50__5D662922.mp3.translation: 机枪火力点！他们把那门高射炮护得严严实实！

0301__L3_SUL_61__B5A006A5.mp3.asr_text: Don't let him set up defensive positions. Move forward. Close the gap.
0301__L3_SUL_61__B5A006A5.mp3.translation: 别让他们站稳脚跟。往前压，贴近他们！

0304__L3_CAR_82__4E6F1E9A.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant, just heard the 8th on the radio. Their guys have located the enemy HQ up ahead, but they're pinned down and need support. Battalion says we're it.
0304__L3_CAR_82__4E6F1E9A.mp3.translation: 中士，刚联系上第八师。他们在前面找到了敌军指挥部，但被火力压住了，需要支援。营部让咱们去。

0305__L3_SUL_76__B79B54C9.mp3.asr_text: Carter! Where's that damn air support?
0305__L3_SUL_76__B79B54C9.mp3.translation: 卡特！该死的空中支援呢？

0306__L3_POL_79__614EADE9.mp3.asr_text: Here they come! And just in time!

0307__L3_SUL_80__B8FBA062.mp3.note: HIT THE DICK疑似Hit the deck误识别，按卧倒口令翻译。

0308__L3_SUL_3__921463C5.mp3.asr_text: Polanski! One more crack from Ewan!
0308__L3_SUL_3__921463C5.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，你再瞎说一句，我就……
0308__L3_SUL_3__921463C5.mp3.note: ASR句尾断词，参考AM仅补足语法关系，保留未说完的威胁。

0310__L3_POL_12__56AEF5A8.mp3.asr_text: Time to dole out a little payback.

0311__L4_MA1_76__D931BA36.mp3.asr_text: Aw hell, they've got tanks! Enemy armor on the horizon!
0311__L4_MA1_76__D931BA36.mp3.translation: 我操，他们有坦克！敌军坦克就在前面！

0312__L3_SUL_118__F64DB22A.mp3.asr_text: They're about to make a push. Miller, make sure none of them get into that HQ.
0312__L3_SUL_118__F64DB22A.mp3.translation: 他们要冲上来了。米勒，别让他们进指挥部！
